verdict.rationale: Cooley publishes named, specific AI-practice products beyond marketing language: Cooley AI (a firm-owned AI company connecting AI to firm knowledge/workflows) and concrete AI-driven S-1 drafting/update tooling with described functionality. This goes beyond a vague marketing mention into named tools and use cases. Missing for 10: detailed public policy documentation on AI governance/ethics, independent press or client corroboration of these tools in use, and more granular detail on how Cooley AI integrates into client workflows.
